text:
oliver: heads-up — ran the terraform quickstart that provisions a demo workspace + service key. firstcall from the provisioned container returns 402 Payment Required and the UI shows a cryptic "payment_required". local manual curl to hosted api with same key works.

nina: can you paste the gateway response body? Is this coming from the provisioning service or the gateway auth layer?

oliver: body:
```json
{"error":"Payment required","code":"payment_required","message":"Workspace billing not active"}
```

qa-bot: automated note: repro steps attached to the ticket OP-712 (terraform quickstart).

infra-raj: interesting — terraform module creates a workspace stub but we don't automatically attach billing contact for demo tenants. Gateway historically returns tenant_blocked for billing-gated requests, but a few newer paths return 402 which the sample UI doesn't handle gracefully.

oliver: that mismatch is the core DX problem. the provisioner gave me a workspace id, the sample printed "ready", but firstcall errors with 402 (no hint or link). took me ages to realize the provisioned workspace needs a billing contact.

devex: proposals: 1) provisioner should emit a post-provision checklist: "To make firstcall succeed, add billing contact or use a workspace with billing enabled" plus a console link. 2) sample container should detect 402/payment_required and surface a direct link to the workspace billing page instead of generic error. 3) SDK should normalize billing-related responses (402/payment_required and 403/tenant_blocked) into a consistent human hint when running in quickstart mode.

nina: agree. for quick wins: add a terraform output note and change the sample app to map 402 -> hint: "Workspace requires billing activation. Visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing". also add a tiny preflight in the container that hits GET /workspaces/<id>/status to verify billing state and fail fast in CI.

infra-raj: i'll patch the terraform module to add a post-provision reminder and optional flag `auto_attach_billing` (default false). we can't auto-add payment details, but we can call out the step clearly. i'll also add a test that the provisioned workspace is not assumed fully provisioned until billing state is active.

qa-bot: queued tests: quickstart-provision-billing-check and sample-402-hint.

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-tf-01 requires billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-tf-01/billing to add payment/contact info.

oliver: with the console link i was able to add billing contact and firstcall succeeded. thanks folks. leaving a short blurb in the onboarding docs about terraform quickstart gotchas. :white_check_mark:

devex: filing tasks: tf-provision-checklist, sample-map-402-to-hint, sdk-billing-normalization. low risk, high UX value. we'll link PRs and the QA tests. :rocket:
